articles.summary: ADM released its 2024 Corporate Sustainability Report covering the company’s activities and progress toward sustainability goals that drive business growth and strengthen global supply chains.

articles.summary: With the unveiling of its 2026 flavor and color trends outlook, ADM predicts that 2026 will be a year to cultivate personal resilience. Consumers around the world are intentionally seeking ways they can overcome persistent challenges and stressors.
articles.title: ADM's 2026 Flavor and Color Trends: A Year to Cultivate Personal Resilience
